question: What fractional measure should be used to begin half the wall width?
premises: A division into seven parts is indicated.
Half the wall width is to be begun.
inference: One should begin half the wall width using one seventh part as specified.
uncertainties: The role of tatpañca in relation to the seven-part division is unclear.
plain_english: One should begin half the wall width as one part out of seven, according to that fivefold measure.
